content:
megan (releases): Quick thread 1826Z7 -- EU canary telemetry flagging p99 regressions after this morning's rollout. Thinking: region-scoped unpin for runtime 3.2 for quantized long-context models?
deploybot: deploy event: runtime 3.2 promoted to EU-canary at 2026-03-21T02:11Z by @sam
megan (releases): Sam, what are the concrete metrics? p95 okay? p99 delta?
sam (eng-runtime): p95 unchanged. p99 increased ~40-60ms on several canary hosts running quant-v4b, seq>8k. Small bump in 5xx rate (~0.2-0.4%). Root appears to be KV-cache eviction churn when the new kernel path meets the SDK streaming pacing change.
jia (eng-sdk): The SDK change switched to chunked flush to reduce memory; it nudges request pacing which affects our continuous batching heuristics. Haven't reproduced at scale locally yet.
pete (eng-sre): Logs from hosts:
```
[eu-host-12] 2026-03-21T02:22:10Z id=abc123 model=quant-v4b seq=10240 kv_evictions=7 latency=312ms
[eu-host-13] 2026-03-21T02:22:11Z id=def456 model=quant-v4b seq=2048 kv_evictions=0 latency=78ms
```
ops-bot: alert: EU-canary runtime-3.2 p99 latency spike threshold breached (30m)
megan (releases): Natalie, any EU customers at risk?
natalie (product): Two pilots using long context in EU; both on Dedicated (not canary). But routing experiments touched canary; conservative approach recommended.
sam (eng-runtime): My suggestion: soft-hold (unpin) runtime 3.2 for quant-v4b in EU until we validate. Leave other models/regions alone.
jia (eng-sdk): Lighter option: roll out SDK pacing fallback for EU canary only (set streaming_pacing=legacy). I can prod a scoped flip and observe. Less disruptive than a runtime pin.
pete (eng-sre): If we do unpin, command we will run: `/deploybot pinback add --component runtime --version 3.1.9 --region eu --models quant-v4b --reason "p99 regression with 3.2" --expires 2026-03-22T08:00Z`. Ops confirms model-scoped pins reroute matching traffic.
ops-bot: confirm: deploybot model-scoped pins supported. Pins are advisory for Dedicated unless routing enforces them per account rules.
jia (eng-sdk): I'll try the SDK toggle first. If we don't see stabilization in 45m, let's execute the pinback. I'll open PR and deploy EU-canary scoped config.
sam (eng-runtime): Please include eviction counts and kv_hit rate in the canary dashboard refresh so we can decide fast.
pete (eng-sre): Added temporary alerts: evictions>3/min and kv_hit<0.5 on canary hosts -> auto-escalate to oncall. I'll also add dashboard filters for quant-v4b.
megan (releases): Plan ack: 1) Jia deploys SDK toggle (+15m). 2) Pete watches alerts; if no improvement in 45m, execute pinback. 3) Sam starts offline repro with longseq to validate root cause. 4) Natalie preps customer comms. Any objections?
sam (eng-runtime): No objections. Prioritizing repro.
jia (eng-sdk): PR opened, deploying EU-canary toggle now. Will paste link and logs.
pete (eng-sre): Alert created, monitoring.
natalie (product): Drafting comms and will coordinate with CSM/legal if we pin.
megan (releases): Deploybot standing by for pinback command. :thumbsup:
deploybot: ack  awaiting pinback command.
megan (releases): Update: Jia deployed toggle at 2026-03-21T02:34Z. Early telemetry: p99 reduced ~10-15ms after 5 minutes, evictions dropped on the worst hosts. Continue monitoring for 30m.
pete (eng-sre): 02:45Z update: p99 delta now +10-15ms vs baseline (was +40-60), evictions on problematic host down 7->1. Keeping alerting active.
megan (releases): Holding off on pinback for now. We keep this thread open until 04:00Z for final go/no-go. If regression returns, we run pinback per Pete's command.
megan (releases): For release notes: add entry under "Canary/resilience notes": SDK streaming pacing interacted with runtime 3.2 kernel path for quantized long-context models; mitigation: SDK canary toggle applied; monitoring augmented; potential region-scoped pin available if needed.
megan (releases): Closing interim thread; will update if we pin or rollback. Thanks everyone.
